answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 21571 Country: India Title: i have to keep qaza fast of many years, however ,due to some problem,i dnt have regular periods. So i dont remember in which ramdhan i missed my fasts. I remember only one year in which i missed my fasts so how should i calculate my missed fasts and what intention should i make while keeping fasts. Please reply soon. Question: Assalamoalaikum. i have to keep qaza fast of many years, however ,due to some problem,i dnt have regular periods. So i dont remember in which ramdhan i missed my fasts. I remember only one year in which i missed my fasts so how should i calculate my missed fasts and what intention should i make while keeping fasts. Please reply soon. JazakAllah. Answer ID: 21571 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 709/497/L=1431) (1) If you have any doubt regarding the number of fasts then follow the maximum numbers i.e. if you do not remember whether you missed 30 fasts or 35, then keep 35 fasts. (2) While keeping fast, make intention that you are doing qaza of fasts of so and so year and if you do not remember year then on every fast you should make intention of doing the qaza of first or last missed fast. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
